       (mediaType text/markdown), not the HTML permalink. */ -}}

{{- $level := .level | default 2 -}}

{{ range where $ctx.RegularPages "Params.excludeSearch" "ne" true -}}
{{- $link := .Permalink -}}

{{- $desc := "" -}}
